components.note: 艹 (grass) — plant radical, as in 花 flower, 草 grass; 薄 first meant a thicket.
溥 (pǔ) is a loose clue; its right part 尃 also sounds out 博 bó and 簿 bù.
金 (metal) — ancient mirrors were bronze, hence 鉴 is a mirror and to examine; as 钅 in 钱 money, 铁 iron.
厂 (cliff, shelter) — a building radical, as in 厅 hall, 厨 kitchen, 厕 toilet.
夏 (xià) shares the rhyme of shà, only a loose sound clue.
扌 (hand) — shaking by force; also in 摇 shake, 推 push.
感 (gǎn) gives a close sound; 憾 hàn shares it and sounds exactly like 撼.
阝 (mound, 左耳旁 on the left) — hills and heights, as in 院, 阳, 队; a cramped, remote hillside place gives 陋 its narrow, crude sense.
⺼ (flesh, 肉月旁) — body parts, as in 脸 face, 胖 plump, 脂 fat.
巴 (bā) is only a loose sound clue for féi.
足 (foot, ⻊) — foot actions, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road.
夭 (yāo) is only a loose sound clue for yuè.
宀 (roof) — a guest under your roof; also in 家 home, 客 guest.
兵 (bīng) gives a close sound; 滨 bīn and 摈 bìn share the part.
女 (woman) — the woman radical, as in 妈 mom, 好 good; its link to 妄 (reckless) is only historical.
亡 (wáng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 忘 wàng and 望 wàng.
彳 (step) — walking and going, as in 行 go, 往 toward; 御 is to drive or manage.
卸 (xiè) is only a loose sound clue for yù.
足 (foot, ⻊) — knees and feet, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump.
危 (wēi) gives a close sound; 诡 guǐ shares it.
车 (vehicle, simplified 車) — the left part, as in 轮 wheel, 辆; the right part 欠 is no real sound clue for ruǎn.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — words and talk, as in 说 say, 话 speech.
䍃 (yáo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 摇 yáo and 遥 yáo.
酉 (wine jar) — drink and its rituals, as in 酒 liquor, 醉 drunk; 酬 first meant to toast a guest.
州 (zhōu) is a loose sound clue; it also sounds out 洲 zhōu.
扌 (hand) — to throw down by hand; also in 打 hit, 扔 throw.
率 (shuài) gives the same syllable with a different tone.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings, as in 快 happy, 怕 afraid; 恨 is hatred in the heart.
艮 (gèn) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 很 hěn, 根 gēn and 跟 gēn.
⺼ (flesh) — body-part radical, as in 肝 liver, 肺 lung, 脑 brain.
田 here is not a field but an old picture of a stomach holding food.
雨 (rain) — weather radical, as in 雷 thunder, 雾 fog; snow is frozen rain.
艹 (grass) — plants; 茄 is the eggplant, as in 花 flower, 草 grass.
加 (jiā) gives the sound in 雪茄 xuě jiā; it also sounds out 架 jià and 嘉 jiā.
米 (rice, grain) — coarse grain, hence rough; also in 粉 powder, 粮 grain.
且 (qiě) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 租 zū and 阻 zǔ.
车 (vehicle) — the spokes of a cartwheel; also in 轮 wheel, 辆 for cars.
畐 (fú) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 福 fú and 幅 fú.
月 (moon) — in the oldest form the sun rises in the grass while the moon is still up: early morning. A court audience was held at dawn, hence cháo for court and dynasty.
⺼ (flesh) — body parts, as in 脸 face, 脚 foot.
宛 (wǎn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 碗 wǎn and 婉 wǎn.
目 (eye) — eyes and seeing, as in 看 look, 睡 sleep, 眼 eye; sleep is closing the eyes.
民 (mín) gives a close sound for mián.
忄 (heart) — a panicked heart; also in 怕 afraid, 急 anxious.
荒 (huāng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 谎 huǎng.
虍 (tiger head) — the striped head and body of a tiger; also in 虑 lǜ, 虚 xū.
卩 (kneeling person) — a figure curled up gives the idea of rolling; 卷 sounds out 圈 quān, 拳 quán and 倦 juàn.
贝 (shell, old money) — payment and loss, as in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
咅 (pōu) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 陪 péi and 培 péi.
舟 (boat) — ships and boats, as in 船 ship, 航 sail.
廷 (tíng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 挺 tǐng and 庭 tíng.
贝 (shell, old money) — giving wealth; also in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
易 (yì) is only a loose sound clue for cì.
目 (eye) — blinking; also in 看 look, 眼 eye.
舜 (shùn) gives the exact sound.
囗 (enclosure) — a ring that encloses; also in 国 country, 围 surround.
卷 (juǎn) gives a close sound; 圈 also reads juàn or juān.
亻 (person) — a person bowing low; also in 他 he, 们 plural.
氐 (dī) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 底 dǐ and 抵 dǐ.
艹 (grass) — plants; 薯 are tubers, as in 花 flower, 草 grass.
署 (shǔ) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 暑 shǔ.
车 (vehicle) — carrying by cart; also in 轮 wheel, 辆 for cars.
俞 (yú) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 愉 yú and 愈 yù.
異 — the usual explanation is a figure holding something on the head, hence to put on or wear on the head.
缶 (earthenware jar) — pottery vessels, as in 缸 vat, 缺 lack.
雚 (guàn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 灌 guàn.
王 (jade, 斜玉旁) — precious gems, as in 球 ball, 珠 pearl, 玩 play.
㐱 (zhěn, the right part 人彡) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 诊 zhěn and 疹 zhěn.
皿 (dish) — a bowl-shaped vessel, as in 盘 plate, 盒 box; a helmet is a bowl for the head.
灰 (huī) shares the rhyme -uī; only a loose sound clue.
禾 (grain) — crops and seasons, as in 种 plant, 秋 autumn, 稻 rice.
子 (child) — 季 was the youngest child, then the last month of a season, then the season itself.
匸 (hiding box) — an enclosure for hiding, as in 区 district, 医 medicine.
若 (ruò) is only a loose sound clue.
矢 (arrow) — the arrow was an ancient measure; also in 知 know, 矮 short, 射 shoot.
豆 (dòu) is only a loose sound clue for duǎn.
艹 (grass) — the lotus plant; also in 花 flower, 草 grass.
何 (hé) gives the exact sound.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads, as in 道 road, 追 chase.
豕 (pig) — the oldest form shows a foot chasing a pig, hence to pursue.
氵 (water) — slow seepage, little by little; also in 河 river, 海 sea.
斩 (zhǎn) is a loose clue; it also sounds out 暂 zàn and 惭 cán.
革 — a hide stretched and scraped; also in 鞋 shoe, 鞭 whip. To renew, hence 革命 revolution.
山 (mountain) — mountain radical, as in 峰 peak, 岛 island, 岸 shore.
石 (rock) — stone on the mountain makes the cliff.
